body: Grace and I leave in a few days for a pilgrimage to Israel. Our primary purpose will not simply be to see the sights where Jesus worked in the past (although that will be wonderful), but rather to see the places where the Spirit of God is working now – for reconciliation, justice, and peace in the midst of turmoil. We have a wonderful group of folks in our little band of travelers, and hopefully you’ll be hearing from several of them as guest bloggers over the next few weeks. If you’ve never subscribed to the site for automatic RSS updates, this would be a great time to do so.
